issues.main_description_html:
API Like Comment

Route: {{base_url}}/comments/like/{commentSid}

  • Prevent liking a comment when the post visibility is private, with the error message: Liking comment not allowed on private posts (Comment Owner).
  • Prevent liking a comment when the post visibility is private, with the error message: Liking Comments not allowed on private posts (Post Owner).
  • Prevent liking a comment when the post visibility is private, with the error message: Liking Comments not allowed on private posts (Other User).

Docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XEa0p1yuB7cRH9z42pQluFYV_EtkEqxpzV0yb8UROBQ/edit?tab=t.0

Flowchart: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1wF_r5JKrQtcLYwCZusqLQT6UWrdUrPIX

Flowchart: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1wF_r5JKrQtcLYwCZusqLQT6UWrdUrPIX

QA Summary - 4 August 2026

Result: Passed. The Live API rejects an authenticated attempt to like a comment belonging to a private post with 403 Forbidden and Liking private comments is not allowed. The blocked request did not mutate the tester data. Authentication and invalid-comment controls also returned controlled 401 and 409 responses; no HTTP 500 was observed.

Private-comment like guard PASS 403 Forbidden, exact response message returned

Invalid-resource control PASS Unknown comment returned 409 Comment Not Found

QA Summary - 4 August 2026

Result: Passed. Live data confirms that the visibility state is handled correctly for the tested read paths: the authenticated owner timeline retains the tester's private, unlisted, and public posts, while the public popular-post feed contains only public posts and exposes none of the tester's private or unlisted post identifiers. No data mutation was needed and no HTTP 500 occurred.
